 How and Where to Watch: FC Porto vs. USC Paredes in the Taça de Portugal LIVE on beIN SPORTS
 FC Porto hosts USC Paredes on Friday, November 20, in the fourth round of the Taça de Portugal. The Portuguese champions will look to extend their remarkable winning form, while the third-division visitors hope to produce another major upset after eliminating Famalicão.
 Watch FC Porto vs USC Paredes LIVE on beIN SPORTS 
 FC Porto vs USC Paredes: How and Where to Watch LIVE 
 The fourth round of the 2026-27 Taça de Portugal begins on Friday, November 20, as FC Porto welcomes USC Paredes to the Estádio do Dragão .
 The matchup brings together two league leaders: Porto sits atop the Primeira Liga with 33 points from 11 matches, while Paredes leads Group A of Portugal's Liga 3 .
 Kickoff is scheduled for 3:45 PM ET / 12:45 PM PT , with coverage beginning at 3:40 PM ET / 12:40 PM PT on beIN SPORTS CONNECT in the United States.
 FC Porto Looks to Extend Its Perfect Domestic League Record 
 FC Porto , managed by Francesco Farioli , enters the competition in outstanding form after winning all 11 of its opening Primeira Liga matches.
 The Dragons secured an emphatic 4-0 victory over Estoril on October 31 before defeating Vitória de Guimarães 2-1 on November 8, with Borja Sainz and Martim Fernandes scoring the goals.
 Porto now holds a five-point advantage over second-placed Benfica and will make its first appearance in this season's Taça de Portugal.
 Farioli has warned against underestimating the opposition, emphasizing that the difference between divisions does not guarantee victory in a knockout competition.
 The Italian coach confirmed that Santiago Giménez is available after returning from international duty, although Pablo Rosario is unlikely to feature due to his late arrival.
 USC Paredes Hopes to Produce Another Cup Upset 
 USC Paredes , coached by Agostinho Bento , arrives at the Estádio do Dragão enjoying an impressive campaign in Portugal's third division.
 The team leads Liga 3 Group A with 22 points from nine matches, having recorded seven victories and established an eight-point advantage over its closest rivals.
 Paredes also comes into the encounter following a 3-1 away victory over AD Marco 09 on November 7, with goals from Miguel Moreno , Yuk and Daniel Rodrigues .
 Its Taça de Portugal journey has been equally impressive. After eliminating Ermesinde 1936 and Maria da Fonte , the team stunned top-flight Famalicão 1-0 in the previous round, thanks to a goal from Moreno .
 Bento has promised an ambitious approach against Porto, while captain Dénis Duarte has emphasized his team's determination to compete at the highest possible level.
 Can Paredes Deliver Another Surprise at the Estádio do Dragão? 
 Despite the difference in divisions, both clubs enter this encounter as leaders of their respective leagues.
 Their only previous official meeting came in the 1989-90 Taça de Portugal , when Porto defeated Paredes 5-0 .
 Porto now begins its pursuit of another domestic cup trophy, while Paredes hopes to repeat the achievement that eliminated Famalicão.
 The winner of Friday's single-elimination match will advance to the round of 16 .
